jobs.description:
In the ever-fascinating world of technology, integration opens endless possibilities. We are here to show companies how integration can empower their digital foundations and fuel business growth. And you have the chance to be at the forefront of the fascinating world of integration with us by joining us as an Integration Engineer.

Who are we?

Meet i8c! An established value within the integration market and part of CornerBriX, the largest integration community in Belgium. i8c is an expert in Hybrid Integration Platforms (HIP), ensuring seamless collaboration between all IT-systems like mobile apps, administrative tools, CRMs, ERPs, Microservices, SaaS platforms, B2B platforms and many more for leading companies in the BeNeLux region.

At i8c, you’ll find a community of integration experts who are here to challenge you, inspire you and support you. You'll always have the freedom to choose your work location, be it at home or one of our remote co-working spaces.

What will your job look like as an Integration Engineer at i8c:

• Take end-to-end ownership for i8c projects, handling development, deployment, and operational maintenance.
• You’ll embrace DevOps principles to achieve optimal uptime and minimize incidents. 
• You’ll learn to master multiple Hybrid Integration Platform (HIP) vendor solutions (IMB, Microsoft, Software AG, TIBCO, Google, Boomi…) establishing new standards and best practices.
• You’ll provide support on a rotational basis as part of a 24/7 standby team, ensuring prompt assistance when required.
• You’ll participate in daily standup meetings 

Who is our i8c Integration Engineer:

• We don't require extensive experience, but eagerness to deep dive into multiple hybrid integration platforms and technologies, such as Software AG webMethods, Tibco Connect, IBM App Connect/API Connect, Microsoft BizTalk and Azure, Google Apigee, and Boomi.
• You are fluent in English, both written as oral.
• You have basic programming experience with Java or .Net, with a focus on back-end development. 
• You are familiar with the concepts and principles of networking, security (DNS, firewalls, HTTP, SSL…) and DevOps (CI/CD, testing…)
• Knowledge of Enterprise Integration Patterns is a plus, just as experience with collaboration tools such as Atlassian, GitLab,…

jobs.occupation: HR Coordinator - International Law firm - Brussels
jobs.description:
International law firm in Brussels.

Jobomschrijving

Soft HR

At Agristo, you are the key player in the packaging process: from frozen fries to a perfectly packaged and palletized product. With your technical affinity and problem-solving abilities, you manage our packaging lines, coordinate the planning, and ensure a flawless process. Are you looking for a challenging role with responsibility, teamwork, and growth opportunities in a dynamic work environment? Join us and grow with a strong, ambitious family business!

What will you be doing at Agristo?
 
• Process Management: You are responsible for the entire packaging process, from frozen fries to a fully palletized and packaged product. 
• Operation and Adjustment: You provide first-line support for any issues on the line, make adjustments when necessary, and continuously expand your technical knowledge of our processes. 
• Planning & Coordination: You monitor and adjust the packaging schedule, coordinating its execution with the team leader to meet the planned goals. 
• Cleanliness and Hygiene: You ensure a clean and organized work environment by overseeing and coordinating cleaning tasks. 
• Material Management: You are responsible for the timely ordering and availability of necessary materials, such as film, cardboard, and spices. 
• Problem Solving: You proactively identify issues in the packaging process and take corrective actions to ensure continuity. 
• Administrative Support: You perform administrative tasks, such as reporting incidents and documenting process information. 
• Packaging Testing: You assist in and conduct packaging process tests in collaboration with Agristo colleagues. 
• Knowledge Sharing: You contribute to the development of instructions and training materials and support knowledge transfer within the team. 
• Employee Guidance: You mentor and support team members, helping them enhance their skills and knowledge.
With this diverse range of responsibilities, you are an essential link in ensuring a smooth and high-quality packaging process!
 
• You have solid experience as a packaging operator in the food industry or have already gained experience in a coordinating role. 
• You possess technical and process insight. 
• You have a problem-solving mindset, are not afraid to critically assess existing processes, and take initiative to implement improvements. 
• You speak Dutch, French, or English and are willing to communicate with colleagues who speak different languages.

As an Inventory Planner Natural Foods, you play a key role in ensuring the right stock is available at the right time. By working closely with production, suppliers, and sales, you help achieve an optimal balance between availability and costs. With your proactive approach, you contribute to a smooth supply chain and sustainable results.
 

Job description
 
 

• Managing and creating purchase orders for production plants, co‑manufacturers, and suppliers based on aligned planning with the demand planning teams. 

• Monitoring and analysing inventory levels to ensure optimal availability and service levels. 

• Proactively communicating about supply and expiry risks and contributing to the implementation of robust inventory management processes and best practices. 

• Aligning with internal production and supply chain teams to follow up on production plans and to identify and mitigate potential supply risks in a timely manner. 

• Monitoring production and transportation flows and ensuring accurate and up‑to‑date data in SAP. 

• Continuously improving and further automating the replenishment process, including optimisation of planning parameters. 

Profile
 

To be able to achieve the above and be successful in this role we believe you need to have:
 
 

• You hold a bachelor’s degree in a business‑related field. 

• You have at least one to two years of experience in supply chain planning, preferably in an FMCG or retail environment, and are familiar with working in a logistics‑ or transport‑oriented customer service setting; knowledge of SAP is a plus. 

• You have strong verbal and written communication skills in English and collaborate smoothly with various internal departments. 

• You work independently and proactively, with a strong attention to detail and a high level of accuracy. 

• You are able to set priorities and work efficiently in a fast‑paced, dynamic environment.

Bedrijfsomschrijving

jobs.occupation: Huxley Associates Belgium - IT & Cyber Third Party Risk Assessor
jobs.description:
We are partnering with our client, a leading organisation in the banking sector, to recruit an experienced IT & Cyber Third Party Risk Assessor for their Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC) team. In this strategic role, you will safeguard our client's operations by assessing and managing IT and cyber risks related to external vendors and intragroup providers, with a strong focus on cloud services and key technology partners.
Working model

• 50% onsite in Brussels

• 50% remote

 

If this aligns with your profile in information security and cyber risk, we would welcome a discussion about joining our client's team.

• Third-Party IT & Security Assessments - Conduct due diligence, evaluate controls and ensure suppliers meet security and regulatory expectations.

• Cloud Security (SaaS, IaaS, PaaS) - Assess cloud solutions and providers, reviewing architectures and risk mitigations.

• Vulnerability Management & Penetration Testing - Analyse reports, challenge remediation plans and track closure of critical findings.

• Application Security - Identify and assess application-related risks and ensure appropriate security measures.

• Risk & Control Frameworks (ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST, OWASP) - Apply recognised standards to structure assessments and recommendations.

• Contractual IT & Cyber Clauses - Review and negotiate security clauses with Procurement and Legal to embed robust protections.

• Audit & GRC Practices - Coordinate supplier audits, use GRC tools (e.g. ServiceNow) and support continuous monitoring.

• Stakeholder Management - Collaborate with cyber defense, security architects, continuity experts, Dpos, and business teams.

• Soft Skills - Strong analytical capabilities, clear communication, structured approach, negotiation skills, and ability to coach and influence across our client's team.

• Languages - French and English are mandatory Dutch is a plus.

Our client is a leading international industrial group with operations across multiple continents and an ambitious growth strategy driven by innovation and strategic investments.

To strengthen its specialist M&A Legal team, the organisation is looking to appoint a Senior Legal Counsel based in Brussels.

Jobomschrijving

As Senior Legal Counsel - M&A, you will act as lead legal adviser on high-profile international transactions.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Leading the legal execution of domestic and international acquisitions, divestitures, joint ventures and strategic investments.
• Managing complex legal due diligence exercises and coordinating specialist legal input across multiple jurisdictions.
• Drafting, reviewing and negotiating transaction documentation, including share purchase agreements, joint venture agreements, transition service agreements, NDAs and other ancillary documents.
• Advising on transaction structuring and identifying pragmatic solutions to legal and commercial risks.
• Partnering with internal stakeholders across Corporate Strategy, M&A, Finance, Treasury, Tax, HR, IT and Compliance throughout the deal lifecycle.
• Managing signing, closing and post-closing processes.
• Supporting integrations, carve-outs and corporate reorganisations following completed transactions.
• Coordinating and managing external legal counsel internationally while maintaining ownership of transaction execution.
• Advising senior management on strategic legal considerations impacting investment decisions.
• Contributing to the continuous development of the company's M&A legal function and best practices.

• Belgian Master's degree in Law.
• Approximately 8+ years of post-qualification experience in Corporate/M&A law.
• Experience gained within a leading international law firm and/or a sophisticated international in-house legal environment.
• Demonstrated experience leading complex domestic and cross-border M&A transactions.
• Excellent drafting, negotiation and project management skills.
• Strong commercial judgement and ability to translate legal complexity into practical business advice.
• Confident communicator with the ability to influence senior stakeholders.
• Fluent in English. French and/or Dutch are considered strong assets.
